bead.title: Allow databricks as an LDP emitter alias
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Direct LDP generation still treats Spark as the only public dialect, so a databricks compile path can fail when it reaches the LDP emitter even if the surrounding compile flow accepts the value.
ROOT CAUSE: src/tablespec/ldp/project.py:242 documents LDP dialect as Spark with duckdb accepted for parity, but omits databricks even though the compile contract now needs it.
PROPOSED FIX: Teach generate_ldp_project to accept dialect="databricks" as a Spark-family alias, keep emitted cast SQL byte-for-byte equivalent to dialect="spark", and add a regression test that locks the parity contract.
NON-SCOPE: One-shot bootstrap facade implementation. Production pipeline JSON/wheel packaging contract. Inline UMF format cleanup. No real Databricks workspace execution beyond existing opt-in tiers. GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-026-compile-orchestrator-bootstrap.md:84; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:49; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:85; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:109. DEPENDENCIES: parent bead tablespec-ed74497c; no additional dependencies.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestGenerateLdpProjectAcceptsDatabricksAlias: add an LDP unit/conformance test proving generate_ldp_project(..., dialect="databricks") succeeds and emits the same Spark-family cast body as dialect="spark".
2. TestGenerateLdpProjectSparkParityRemainsStable: add a regression test proving the spark and databricks outputs stay identical for cast SQL and do not diverge in unrelated sections of the LDP payload.
3. TestPytestGate: `uv run pytest tests/ldp/test_ldp_emitter.py tests/ldp/test_ldp_cast_parity.py`
4. TestGoGate: `go test ./...`
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit`
